title: mere moula mujhe do sahara
body:
mere moula mujhe do sahara, maine thaama hai daaman tumhara
dhalde sooraj ko tumhe ubhaara, maine thaama hai daaman tumhara
<<DIVIDER>>
tum hi mushkil kushaae jaha'n ho , tum hi moulae kouno makaa'n ho
ambiya ne bhi tumko pukaara, maine thaama hai daaman tumhara
<<DIVIDER>>
meri kashti bhawar me phasi hai, dushmano ke labo par hasi hai
kardo nazdeek mujh se kanaara, maine thaama hai daaman tumhara
<<DIVIDER>>
gardisho me muqaddar hai mera, kya karu chaarsu hai andhera
tum jo chaaho to chamke sitaara, maine thaama hai daaman tumhara
<<DIVIDER>>
ranj me kabse mai mubtela hu, kab se moula aseere bala hu
kya tadapna mera hai gawaara, maine thaama hai daaman tumhara
<<DIVIDER>>
mustafa ke lie ab bachaao, fatima ke lie jaa'n chudaao
ab to mutlaq nahi gham ka yaara, maine thaama hai daaman tumhara
<<DIVIDER>>
tumko moula hasan ki duhaai, sarwaro bekafan ki duhaai
sunlo faryaad meri qudaara, maine thaama hai daaman tumhara
<<DIVIDER>>
behre abbas baazu ko thaamo, bediya behre sajjad kaato
ya ali mai hu banda tumhaara, maine thaama hai daaman tumhara
<<DIVIDER>>
waasta akbare noujawa ka, waasta cheh mahine ki jaa'n ka
kardo rehmat bas ab ishaara, maine thaama hai daaman tumhara
<<DIVIDER>>
zahno dil par laakh aari, mad'ha kaise rukegi tumhaari
tumne khud fikr ko hai sawaara, maine thaama hai daaman tumhara
<<DIVIDER>>
apne *kirmani* par rehm khaao, jald rouze pa moula bulaao
dar dikhaado mujhe ab tumhaara, maine thaama hai daaman tumhara
